Trace, implement and test: 面试题68 I. 二叉搜索树的最近公共祖先

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(NULL), right(NULL) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    TreeNode* lowestCommonAncestor(TreeNode* root, TreeNode* p, TreeNode* q) {
        if (root->val < p->val && root->val < q->val) {
            return lowestCommonAncestor(root->right, p, q);
        }
        if (root->val > p->val && root->val > q->val) {
            return lowestCommonAncestor(root->left, p, q);
        }
        return root;
    }
};
